text:
Hiromi Tanaka: hey team! hiromi here — excited to join the infra squad. first-day checklist done but stuck on MDM enrollment and vpn. any pointers? :wave:
Mara Chen: welcome Hiromi!! :tada: i'm your manager. ping me for infra onboarding. for MDM, follow the guide in #devex (search 'mdm-enroll') — if MDM installer fails, paste the error here.
Hiromi Tanaka: thanks mara! the installer crashes at 'mobileconfig install' step. i can paste logs after i get coffee :coffee:
Jess O'Neil: hi hiromi, welcome! People Ops sent your laptop already — should be labeled at shipstation. for AWS creds, open the internal SF ticketing portal and request 'infra dev access' and tag @Rafael Silva.
Rafael Silva: hey hiromi — i'll approve once the ticket shows up. quick tip: to test vpn run:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_dev id@bastion.redwood.internal
```
if that times out, post the traceroute.
Hiromi Tanaka: trying ssh now... getting 'permission denied (publickey)'
Mara Chen: that usually means your public key didn't sync. did you upload the SSH key to the onboarding form? if not, paste the key here (or DM).
Hiromi Tanaka: uploaded now. also — where do y'all get ramen near the office? i'm bringing recommendations from tokyo :ramen:
Rafael Silva: ramen recs = Ichiraku (5 min walk) and Ramen Labs two doors down. also welcome kit includes a ramen sticker pack, @Jess can confirm :stuck_out_tongue:
Jess O'Neil: confirmed — will add 'ramen sticker' to your swag pick. also cc'ing DevOnboardBot to open a follow-up for MDM + SSH sync.
DevOnboardBot: Ticket #ONB-4821 created: 'Hiromi Tanaka — Fix MDM enrollment and SSH key sync'. Assigned: Rafael Silva. ETA: today EOD.
Hiromi Tanaka: perfect, thanks everyone! i'd love to pair on the first infra task later today — mara, can we schedule 2pm PT? i'm in JST but flexible. :calendar:
Mara Chen: 2pm PT works for me. i'll drop a calendar invite. welcome aboard again! :tada::rocket:
Rafael Silva: see you at pairing. if anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall.
Hiromi Tanaka: got it, thanks! — Hiromi
